title: Exactly-one constraint formula
statement: For a list $v_s$ of natural-number variables, form a CNF formula whose first clause contains the positive literal for each variable in $v_s$, in list order. For each variable $v$ in the list, also include a negative-literal clause for every variable $w$ in the list with $w\ne v$, consisting of the negative literals for $v$ and $w$ in that order.
